title: A TLV encoder
description:
Serialise values as type-length-value records that old readers can skip.

```
encode {name: "ada", level: 7, admin: true}
-> 01 03 'ada' 02 04 07 00 00 00 03 01 01
decode -> name ada, level 7, admin true
unknown tag 09 skipped
```
hints: Write a helper `put(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out, std::uint8_t tag, const void* data, std::uint8_t size)` (lesson 5.03).
For decoding, check `pos + 2 + length <= bytes.size()` before reading each value.
requirements: Each record is a tag byte, a length byte and the value bytes.
A reader skips unknown tags with the length and refuses records that run past the end.
stretch: Allow lengths over 255 with a variable-length integer.
